title: BILLIE EILISH
description: Mega-selling 21st-century pop icon with unique anthems that defy categorisation. Billie talks directly to a new generation of music fans and is renowned for her spectacular live shows, the perfect headliner for day one.

title: SAM FENDER
description: Elton John-approved rootsy indie rock singer/songwriter, perfect for modern times with a quirky selection of witty storylines that nod to Brit Pop and have even found their way into the school curriculum.

title: ROBERT PLANT & ALISON KRAUSS
description: The perfect union of Plant’s eclectic love of all music – from folk and soul to the blues - and Alison Krauss’ earthy bluegrass country as typified on their second recording collaboration of last year ‘Raise The Roof’.

title: WOLF ALICE
description: Mercury Prize and BRIT award winning Londoners return to Glastonbury on the back of their critically acclaimed third album ‘Blue Weekend’; an emotional widescreen dream pop opus.

title: CROWDED HOUSE
description: Antipodean brothers Tim and Neil Finn (plus Neil’s two sons Liam and Elroy) with a career-spanning romp through their back pages right up to last year’s long-awaited return ‘Dreamers Are Waiting’.

title: RUFUS WAINWRIGHT
description: The Renaissance man of baroque pop with a side order of show tunes and plenty of operatic drama to boot.

title: ZIGGY MARLEY
description: Multi Grammy-award winning reggae icon, the son of Bob And Rita Marley with a beautiful live tribute to his father.

title: PAUL MCCARTNEY
description: The legendary Sir Paul fulfils his much-anticipated Glastonbury 50 engagement: Expect excerpts from all solo albums, Wings and the Fab Four, of course.

title: NOEL GALLAGHER'S HIGH FLYING BIRDS
description: Celebrating ten years of high flying solo freedom, Noel and co offer an insight into his journey from Brit Pop activist to Pop Psych navigator via the Baggy revolution.

title: HAIM
description: American West Coast sisters with a love of brash guitars and super close harmonies from the edgier side of soft rock with a touch of RnB swagger.

title: AJ TRACEY
description: ‘Ladbroke Grove’ hitmaker, rapper, singer, songwriter and record producer who sparred with Stormzy and Headie One on ‘Ain't It Different’.

title: EASY LIFE
description: Former BBC Introducing Stage headliners at Glastonbury in 2019, who’ve been taking their wonky hip hop pop global ever since via a torrent of singles covering life, love and saving the planet.

title: JOY CROOKES
description: South London singer/songwriter who embraces her own culture via her stylish mix of neo soul and alternative RnB as displayed on last year’s debut album ‘Skin’.

title: LES AMAZONES D'AFRIQUE
description: World music super group of celebrated contemporary African artists.

title: KENDRICK LAMAR
description: Heralded as the new king of hip hop in many corners, the producer and singer/songwriter continues to embrace funk, soul, spoken word and progressive rap, creating his own distinctive and truly evocative sound.

title: LORDE
description: Dreamy style-switching electro pop from the hugely influential singer whose unique delivery and incisive lyrics singled her out as an one of the most inspirational artists from the last decade.

title: ELBOW
description: The eternally alternative and superbly spacious maestro’s return following the critical acclaim for their ninth studio album ‘Flying Dream 1’ from late last year.

title: DIANA ROSS
description: Multi-hit making soul legend and former Supreme with all the tunes from ‘Baby Love’ and ‘Where Did Our Love Go’ to ‘I’m Still Waiting’ and ‘Love Hangover’.

title: HERBIE HANCOCK
description: Enormously innovative Oscar and Grammy winning post bop jazz and early jazz funk keyboard pioneer who has played with everyone from Miles Davis to Joni Mitchell.

title: DAKHABRAKHA
description: Ukrainian folk quartet combining the musical styles of several ethnic groups whose name derives from the phrases “give” and “take”.

title: BLACK DYKE BAND
description: One of the oldest and best-known brass bands in the world; the glorious sound of West Yorkshire.

title: FOALS
description: Feeling slightly funkier on their just-released seventh studio album, ‘Life Is Yours’, Foals have gravitated to an inspirational pristine pop sound stuffed full of good vibes.

title: ST. VINCENT
description: Iconic triple Grammy winning songwriter who dips into a multitude of genres to create a unique sound imbibed with succinct confessional prose as typified on last year’s celebrated ‘Daddy’s Home’ album.

title: IDLES
description: Everyone’s favourite abrasive, angsty new punk rock phenomena, flaunting tradition and good sense to produce a euphoric racket for a mosh pit near you.

title: SUPERGRASS
description: Britpop survivors with a bag full of hits rom ‘Alright’ and ‘Richard III’ onwards, the perfect good time sound – smoke a fag, put it out, yeah!

title: FIRST AID KIT
description: The Swedish folk duo who embraced Americana, indie and country on their quest to fashion a unique multi-layered sound of lush harmonies and joyous melody.

title: BLOSSOMS
description: After three chart topping albums, their just released fourth ‘Ribbon Around The Bomb’ matures their indie jangle pop, with songwriting chops compared to Paul Simon and Noel Gallagher among others.

title: KAE TEMPEST
description: The spoken word performer, poet, recording artist, novelist and playwright holds forth on life and all its intricacies.

title: THE LIBERTINES
description: The bad boys of post post post post punk with an explosion of pop hits from ‘Up The Bracket’ to the aching glory of the anthemic ‘Gunga Din’.

title: MEGAN THEE STALLION
description: “Real hot girl shit” from the freestyling maestro and Queen of Texas rap. This will be one of the moments of the weekend, one to drop into conversations for years to come.

title: BURNA BOY
description: Seasoned African rapper whose Afro fusion mixes up dancehall, Afrobeat, rap and RnB to create a completely infectious groove punctuated by his well observed words.

title: OLIVIA RODRIGO
description: TV star, actress and pop sensation whose ‘Sour’ album topped the charts everywhere last year, with an anthem-heavy set gliding between upbeat pop punk and tearjerking ballads.

title: GLASS ANIMALS
description: Champions of swinging sun-drenched pop music with a penchant for hard-edged realism hidden in their dance-friendly tunes.

title: METRONOMY
description: Super sweet modern pop sounds as sampled on their gorgeous new ‘Small World’ album; filled with classy melodies and overflowing with positivity.

title: SKUNK ANANSIE
description: Former Pyramid headliners ratcheting up their rock bravado behind the soaring vocals of the magnificent Skin.

title: TEMS
description: Multi-award winning, US Billboard-charting Nigerian soul singer blending the sweet sounds of RnB with some evocative African rhythms to make a swooning groove like no other.

title: PET SHOP BOYS
description: The masters of synth pop eccentricity, over 30 years in the making and still delivering floor wobbling anthems from ‘It’s A Sin’ - the song (see what we’ve done there) right through to ‘Dreamland’ which featured Years & Years (it’s all making sense now).

title: YEARS & YEARS
description: The dancefloor-aimed electropop vehicle of actor, TV presenter, broadcaster and all round good guy Olly Alexander, star of the award winning It’s A Sin TV series.

title: KACEY MUSGRAVES
description: Revitalising country music with her own spin on storytelling that touches on self-doubt and nostalgia spiked with her patented sassy defiance.

title: FONTAINES DC
description: Moving swiftly beyond their indie roots with this year’s ‘Skinty Fia’ album, Fontaines DC mix cracking pop tunes with melancholy laments for their homeland.

title: DECLAN MCKENNA
description: Former Glastonbury Emerging Talent winner turned pop sensation, songwriter, producer and political activist with some top tunes to boot.

title: LIANNE LA HAVAS
description: Introspective and supremely soulful singer songwriter and producer with an impeccable voice and some provocative personal tales to unravel.

title: SEA GIRLS
description: Champions of the indie anthem and masters of the opulent guitar break, Sea Girls came of age with this year’s highly praised ‘Homesick’ album.

title: KOJEY RADICAL
description: Rapper, creative director and mixed media visual artist with a style that has been described as a mix of grime-y hip hop, alternative rap and spoken word.

title: LITTLE SIMZ
description: Since making her Glastonbury debut on West Holts in 2016, Simz has been on a meteoric ascent culminating in the release of her much lauded album ‘Sometimes I Might Be Introvert’.

title: BONOBO
description: Simon Green, AKA Bonobo, is one of the biggest names in dance music and his latest album ‘Fragments’, has been hailed as his best yet.

title: SEUN KUTI & EGYPT 80
description: Seun has performed with Egypt 80 since childhood, becoming leader when Fela Kuti passed in 97. The revolutionary sound of Afrobeat has since become ever more influential.

title: TLC
description: With over 70 million records sold, TLC set the benchmark for contemporary RnB and tracks like ‘Creep’, ‘Waterfalls’ and ‘No Scrubs’ still sound as sharp, sassy and sexy as ever.

title: SLEAFORD MODS
description: Our favourite foul-mouthed left-wing duo continue to rage against the system after numerous albums with wit-sharpened invective and razor-edged beats.

title: GREENTEA PENG
description: The spiritual and political threads of Peng’s output are tightly interwoven. She describes her trippy neo soul as “rebel music to raise the vibration”.

title: AROOJ AFTAB
description: The Grammy winning track, ‘Mohabbat’ perfectly encapsulates a sound that’s rooted in Sufi traditions but very much in the present; a sublime and emotionally captivating performer.

title: NUBIYAN TWIST
description: An exhilarating ten-piece drawing on jazz, highlife, Latin, soul and dub whose live prowess landed them a slot at David Byrne’s Meltdown Festival.

title: ROISIN MURPHY
description: Since her early days with Moloko, Róisín has gifted an amazing stream of dancefloor bangers from a twisted disco; her theatrical live shows are pure creative hedonism.

title: CARIBOU
description: If Dan Snaith had set out to create a band just to perform a Glastonbury sunset slot, he couldn’t have done a better job than Caribou as they meld dream pop, folktronica and all points between.

title: LEON BRIDGES
description: Last year’s ‘Gold-Diggers’ album saw Bridges move beyond his retro soul roots to become RnB royalty and subsequent collaborations with Khruangbin have expanded his reach yet further.

title: CELESTE
description: A voice that marries the emotional heft of Billie Holiday with the majestic charisma of Amy Winehouse is one to treasure.

title: YVES TUMOR
description: Rapidly becoming a live phenomenon, channelling Bowie, Prince and Mick Jagger, Tumor delivers carnal glam rock with deeply visceral grooves.

title: BLACK MIDI
description: A sonic maelstrom of prog, jazz, psych and blues that catapults the audience from mesmerising calm to raging moshpit and back again.

title: BRASS AGAINST
description: The NYC brass collective deliver joyful protest music that has seen them support the likes of Tool and Rage Against The Machine.

title: KIKAGAKU MOYO
description: After five albums and countless live shows, the Japanese psych gods are looking to end the project “on the highest note possible”. An unmissable trip.

title: BICEP
description: After rapidly scaling the ranks to become one of the biggest live draws in dance music, their spectacular production will make for an epic closing party on Wets Holts.

title: ANGELIQUE KIDJO
description: The undisputed queen of African music has amassed an astonishing list of achievements in her career and collaborated with everyone from Burna Boy to Yo-Yo Ma.

title: KOFFEE
description: Still only 22 and having just released her debut album, Mikayla “Koffee” Simpson has already become the most exciting new voice in reggae.

title: SNARKY PUPPY
description: The most exciting instrumental big-band out there, Snarky Puppy have earned huge critical acclaim including a string of Grammys.

title: NUBYA GARCIA
description: One of the leading figures in the new British jazz explosion, Nubya’s sound is muscular but romantic and succinctly influenced by her Afro-Caribbean roots.

title: NIGHTMARES ON WAX
description: George Evelyn’s latest album, ‘Shout Out! To Freedom’ is a career best and highlights just how influential his cosmic beats have become.

title: EMMA-JEAN THACKRAY
description: The spiritual jazz with dancefloor leanings of her debut album ‘Yellow’ confirmed the young multi-instrumentalist and producer as a major new talent.

title: ISHMAEL ENSEMBLE
description: Bristol collective fusing jazz, electronica and a touch of Krautrock to form a lushly pulsating soundscape.

title: PRIMAL SCREAM
description: Bringing their greatest hits from head rock to dancefloor-friendly beats, with a few chunkier riffs for texture.

title: THE JESUS AND MARY CHAIN
description: The Reid brothers’ incendiary feedback-heavy atmospherics and multi-layered shoegaze pop still holds good some 39 years after they first emerged.

title: PHOEBE BRIDGERS
description: West Coast indie folk with a deep and emotional edge, or as her potty mouthed website proclaims; music from a haunted house with a picket fence.

title: SIGRID
description: Striking a melancholy mood that’s offset by some upbeat grooves including last year’s dancefloor classic ‘Mirror’ and this year’s collaboration with Bring Me The Horizon.

title: GIRL IN RED
description: Indie bedroom pop all the way from Norway that mixes and matches dream pop ambience and back chat rap breaks all filled with eloquent wordplay.

title: INHALER
description: Brash indie pop bolstered by stadium rock-approved guitars underpinning some well-seasoned angst behind their lovelorn storylines.

title: GRIFF
description: BRIT-winning electropop singer songwriter with a mellow RnB vibe, bringing an upbeat worldview along with a few darker anthems.

title: BAD BOY CHILLER CREW
description: As seen on TV; three MC’s - Kane, GK and Sam – with one bassline house vision on tales of scoobys and BMWs.

title: JAMIE T
description: Singer songwriter, often described as the bastard son of Billy Bragg, Joe Strummer and Mike Skinner, ahead of his fifth album ‘The Theory Of Whatever’.

title: GHETTS
description: Acclaimed grime star who combines razor-sharp rhymes delivered in his crystal clear flow with a healthy dose of humour.

title: PA SALIEU
description: Tough uncompromising raps from the streets of Coventry; deep rooted in Salieu’s Gambian heritage.

title: BEABADOOBEE
description: A heady reinterpretation of what’s possible in music traversing fuzzy rock, classic singer-songwriter, psychedelia, midwest emo and outright pop.

title: SELF ESTEEM
description: The pleasure prioritising singer songwriter with her own line in quirky indie that varies from arty self-examination to syncopated dance moves; a fantastic conundrum.

title: HOLLY HUMBERSTONE
description: Mellow aching sounds that embrace both indie pop and synth pop from the BRIT-winning singer songwriter.

title: ENNY
description: The ‘Peng Black Girls’ rapper with a fine line in wordy narratives telling tales of downtown London.

title: GO_A
description: Esoteric drum-laden Ukrainian electro-folk with some soaring vocals and an infectious rhythm.

title: CHARLI XCX
description: Taking the concept of pop into new territory by mixing synth pop and dance music into an experimental hybrid that sounds like nothing else.

title: LITTLE DRAGON
description: Unhurried, off-kilter RnB, pop and symphonic electronics from the ever-evolving Swedish quartet whose new album underlines their dancefloor credentials.

title: TURNSTILE
description: Amazing hardcore outfit whose ‘Glow On’ album took the genre to new heights merging hard rock, ambient breaks and intricate songwriting.

title: AMYL AND THE SNIFFERS
description: Mullet-toting Australian four piece weened on the excesses of primal punk rock, delivering their own gargantuan sound as a result.

title: CLAIRO
description: Bitterweeet indie-folk from the millions-of-YouTube-hits American singer songwriter whose bedroom pop has gone stratospheric.

title: SPORTS TEAM
description: Fuzzy, unconventional alternative indie powered by some punk pop melody lines and the upbeat fervour and showmanship of singer Alex Rice.

title: JUST MUSTARD
description: Scratchy atmospheric dream popsters with some epic tunes.

title: FOUR TET
description: The electronic façade for the multi-talented composer, improviser, remixer and producer Kieren Hebden.

title: KHRUANGBIN
description: Texan trio blending all kinds of musical inspiration from funk, psych and Tropicalia to rock, dub and beyond.

title: ARLO PARKS
description: Award winning soulful singer songwriter and poet whose rise to prominence through lockdown was one of the few silver linings of recent times.

title: DRY CLEANING
description: The hyper mundanity of Englishness unravelled by restrained vocalist Florence Shaw over an abrasive and immersive post-punk soundclash.

title: CONFIDENCE MAN
description: Hyper-charged OTT electro pop all the way from Australia, adding an emotional maturity on their second album ‘Tilt’ from earlier this year.

title: WET LEG
description: Reclining ‘Chaise Longue’ duo with an ironic swirl of good humour littered throughout their indie pop anthems.

title: MATILDA MANN
description: Alternative indie singer songwriter, one of the highlights from last year’s Emerging Talent Competition.

title: JAMZ SUPERNOVA PRESENTS WITH ANNIE MAC, JESHI + SAM INTERFACE
SPORTS BANGER: MEGA RAVE THE RETURN W/ HARRIMANN, JAY CARDER, KLOSE ONE, TASHA, JONNY BANGER + GUESTS
A J LAMBERT
description: Frank Sinatra’s granddaughter was bound to be very talented…with a very different sound and arrangement style, Amanda produces an incredible soundscape that sweeps us up into ethereal verses and catchy choruses. Be prepared for some awesome covers of her grandfather’s big numbers.

title: JESS ISZATT (BBC RADIO 1) DJ TRANSGRESSIVE TAKEOVER
ROSCO SHAKES
description: Real musicians playing real music…Funky jazz n blues with lashings of honky-tonk piano, moog slides and kick ass solos from every band member. WARNING: You will NOT be able to stand still.

title: MIK ARTISTIK'S EGO TRIP
description: Probably the funniest man we have ever had the honour of putting on at the Rabbit Hole. Mik is a consistently absurd presence on the festival scene and is unmissable if you want your sides to ache whilst trying to dance…

title: BEANS ON TOAST
description: Utterly brilliant musical comedy and social political satire, Mr Beans pushes the envelope of decency and good taste. Do NOT bring grandma!

title: JESSE MALIN
description: Jesse is on a grand tour at the moment and is set to be internationally massive. Come and see him here first before he gets onto the bigger stages…

title: LYZA
description: Joe Strummer obviously gave birth to another musician, Lyza…Here she is with her soft, soulful and enigmatic songs.

title: TALIESIN
description: A beautiful collection of self-written love songs backed by laidback guitar riffs.

title: JESSIE WARE
description: Hailed as steamy and scintillating grown up pop for her most recent album, the versatile voice-for-hire for everyone from Kylie to Sampha brings her understated RnB for a spectacular headline slot.

title: MITSKI
description: Cult pop singer songwriter spinning tales about heartbreak and capitalism with a theatrical delivery and a fine sense of irony.

title: THE AVALANCHES
description: Australian sound manipulators, crafting decks, effects and a million samples into well-tooled wonky pop songs.

title: BIG THIEF
description: Grammy-nominated indie rock four-piece with a melancholy take on folk on brittle but beautifully crafted songs that revolve around intimate recollections and the tender voice of Adrienne Lenker.

title: SQUID
description: Motorik-rhythmed post punk combo with a multi-layered hypnotic sound that builds to an all-embracing state of euphoria.

title: SAMPA THE GREAT
description: Zambian rapper who’s featured with a host of hip hop luminaries as well as delving deep into themes of home, heritage, displacement and freedom on her own huge selling releases.

title: GABRIELS
description: Close-knit trio making sweet soul with vocalist Jacob Lusk providing the wow factor with a ridiculously engaging vocal delivery.

title: KATY J PEARSON
description: Alt-indie folk rock with a nod to Americana, some sweet melodies and a melodious vocal.

title: YASMIN WILLIAMS
description: Finger-style guitarist and singer songwriter producing beautiful textured soundtracks with her virtuoso playing.

title: SPECIAL REQUEST PRESENTS W/ ANZ, ECLAIR FIFI + KETTAMA
PRETTY WEIRD W/ FLOATING POINTS, OR:LA, CHLOÉ ROBINSON B2B DJ ADHD
LUKE UNA PRESENTS É SOUL CULTURA
THE EGG
description: Now, almost residents at the Rabbit Hole, The egg take us into the late night stratosphere with live psychedelic funk. What to bring? bacon or toast soldiers…

title: BRASS FUNKEYS
description: Does what it says on the tin… We love this load of great musicians from the Bristol massive who can blow you away with funk!

title: SHELF LIVES
description: Absolutely brilliant high-energy duo tear the stage apart with Tech-Rock and f**k off-lyrics…

title: DJ LILY BLUE & DJ NORTY MORTY
EMMANUEL JAL & NYARUACH
description: Brother and sister come together after years of separation in war-torn Sudan with the sounds of their village woven into an infectious, trance-like dance music. EDM meets Africa…

title: JACK TYSON CHARLES
description: Son and heir to the Craig Charles Clan, Jack is his own man and belts out tune after glorious tune with piano and vocals that he seems to summon up from some deep and mysterious well of talent within.

title: BEA
description: Up and coming singer songwriter with a stunning voice and great songs with lyrics that belie her youth.

title: JESS PHILLIPS MP WITH JOHN ROBB
SLAMBOREE DJ SET FT SPECIAL GUESTS
POWER BALLAD YOGA PRESENTS BACK TO THE CHAKRA (WHERE WE'RE GOING, WE DON'T NEED PANTS)
COURTNEY BARNETT
description: Magnificent earthy punk simplicity colliding with a unique word-heavy stream of deadpan consciousness.

title: JARV IS
description: The wonderfully unique Jarvis Cocker’s most cohesive post-Pulp project, mainlining his inner Elvis meets Scott Walker.

title: CAROLINE POLACHEK
description: Arty alternative pop with an experimental glitchy strangeness and arrangements that elevate each song into its own surreal universe.

title: CATE LE BON
description: Offbeat guitar-mangled Welsh speaking indie with an alluring baroque pop edginess; one of the great new songwriters and producers.

title: WARMDUSCHER
description: Acclaimed as the sleaziest, most debauched, and downright addictive experiences in London's guitar underground, how can you resist?

title: BIG JOANIE
description: Strident Kill Rock Stars-affiliated three-piece punk band with a tub-thumping stand-up drummer and some caustic guitar.

title: DEEP THROAT CHOIR
description: All-female singing collective, just voices and drums, attempting to bring music back to basics.

title: TIM REAPER PRESENTS FUTURE RETRO W/ DWARDE + MANTRA
DAJU W/ HELENA STAR B2B NIKS + MORE
SOCIAL 23: CELEBRATING 23 COSMIC YEARS OF THE SOCIAL
HARDWICKE CIRCUS
description: When a request from Paul McCartney came through to Rabbit Hole HQ to ask if we could fit in a band he is a fan of, the White Rabbit’s ears pricked up… A new outfit from Cumbria, Hardwicke Circus are, in our opinion, going to be enormous. Their first album, The Borderland is a blindingly brilliant debut..every song is a massive tune and the sound is somewhere between Crash Test Dummies, Dexys Midnight Runners, The Clash and the Arctic Monkeys…If there is one band NOT to miss this weekend, it’s these guys..That’s why we have put them conveniently in our 2022 Headline slot !

title: GABO
description: Where Africa meets Jazz funk. Watch the Rabbit Hole dissolve into mayhem.

title: PUMAROSA
description: If you haven’t heard of them yet, you will do in the future. These guys give us live electronic dance music that gets into a psychedelic groove that sails onwards like a sonic infection.

title: NICK MULVEY
description: Well..what can we say? It’s just an absolute honour to have Nick in our humble Rabbit Hole.

title: SINEAD O'BRIEN
description: From the Emerald Isle and set to take the world of music by storm, this young woman is unusually blessed with a great voice, poetry, incredible stage presence and a backing band who are able to create a soundscape of rare brilliance. See her at The Rabbit Hole first, before she wins all the awards the music industry can throw at her.

title: MATTERS UNKNOWN
description: Several incredibly talented musicians having the time of their lives experimenting with drum n bass jazz funk. Proper muso’s musicians!

title: WOOM
description: All girl group who sing together in 4 part harmony. dreamy, tuneful and spectacularly lovely.

title: HARMONY TUNBRIDGE
description: The clue is in her name. Harmony has a lovely and unique voice and weaves tales of intimacy and friendship…Her honesty is beguiling and refreshing in a world of so many songwriters using all the usual tropes.

title: EATS EVERYTHING PRESENTS FONDA PUDDING B2B THE PINK PANTHER
BAGGY MONDAYS
description: The legendary Madchester-flavoured indie-disco is back to kickstart another Glastonbury with a Thursday afternoon session. Get there early and be ready to sing loud!

title: EATS EVERYTHING PRESENTS HISTORY OF RAVE
MR BRUCE
description: Former Correspondents front man, Mr Bruce is that brilliantly bendy and extraordinarily engaging performer who you want to see over and over again.

title: SUBTLE MACHINES
description: Proper jazz funk with a psychedelic twist……played by an all-star group of incredible musicians.

title: DJ MIKEY SNOOZE & DJ WORK EXPERIENCE
BAD BOY CHILLER CREW
description: The funniest thing to come out of Bradford since the last funny thing, this crew are doing all they can to discredit street life in the North of the UK. Lyrics that cause rioting, mixed with unlawful use of quad-bikes on virgin golf-courses, these boys mean what they say and say what they mean.

title: PURPLE RAVE WITH ROB DA BANK & TAYO
LEKIDDO - LORD OF THE LOBSTERS!
description: There can be only one…Now an infamous and notorious regular at The Rabbit Hole, the great leader of crustaceans returns to pedal his unfeasibly absurd musical Prawn Cocktail.

title: MURRAY LAUCHLAN YOUNG
description: You may have heard poetry before.. but NOT like this…Murry has been resident poet at Radio Six for many years and unearths the craziest, sideways shit you’ve ever heard.

title: OSCAR DUNBAR
description: We at the Rabbit Hole reserve our Thursday afternoon for the winners and runners-up of the Emerging Taleompetition at Glastonbury...This young up-and-coming star was not in the talent competition, but I hazard a guess that, if he had been, he might have won. An amazingly buoyant voice, tune-perfect hooks and a twinkling pop-funk sound. See him here, in a small intimate space before he goes big.

title: LEWIS MCLAUGHLIN
description: Every now and again, a song finds its way through all of the din. And when ‘Glastonbury Central’ heard Lewis MccLaughlin’s song “Summer” we all knew that he would win the emerging talent competition 2022. A true star in the making… See him close up and personal at the rabbit hole before he explodes onto the pyramid stage!

title: SOFY (EMERGING TALENT FINALIST)
description: SOFY has been described by Sam Fender and Yungblud as “proper British music” with “that Lilly (Allen) attitude”. The Emerging Talent Competition runner-up cites her main musical influences as two decades of FIFA Soundtracks (See: The Streets, Blur, Stone Roses, Loyle Carner, & Easy Life) and a love for classic 90’s hip-hop. Expect big Brit-pop inspired choruses, soulful moments, and tons of sharp & witty lyricism.

title: PAUL HEATON & JACQUI ABBOTT
description: Beautiful South mainstays continuing to add to their veritable grab bag of lovingly observed soap operas perfectly illustrating life in modern times.

title: THE UNDERTONES
description: Legendary Peel-approved sub-three minute pop songs throwing together the rootsy garage punk of 60s America and the raucous joy of late 70s new wave.

title: HOTHOUSE FLOWERS
description: Evergreen Dubliners continuously stirring up the spirit of rock ‘n’ roll and atmospheric Americana with their unique homegrown sound.

title: BRIAN KENNEDY
description: Revered Celtic-soul songwriter and occasional sparring partner for Boy George and Stevie Wonder discovered by Van Morrison, no less.

title: MARY COUGHLAN
description: Folk royalty with a voice compared to everyone from Billie Holliday to Shirley Bassey singing songs hewn from the human heart.

title: THE MARIACHIS
description: Authentic Doritos-approved ‘go to’ mariachi resplendent with covers of punk and new wave oddities that’s been loved by millions following a myriad of TV appearances.

title: IRISH MYTHEN
description: Award-handed singer songwriter delivering raw power and emotion in her folky repertoire that’s been hailed as a musical force of nature.

title: PAVEY ARK
description: Cinematic folk music mixing distinctive guitar and complex percussion; think Radiohead jamming with cult folk icon Nick Drake.

title: ROSEANNE REID
description: The Proclaimers’ Craig Reid’s younger sister rewriting the rules of vintage Americana and gaining a host of plaudits along the way.

title: NOVELTY ISLAND
description: Quirky cut-up pop with nods to The Beach Boys, Boards Of Canada and The Beatles, all succumbing to a surreal northern nervous breakdown.

title: THE WATERBOYS
description: Led by the mercurial Mike Scott, rekindling the magnificence of their ‘The Whole Of The Moon’ through to this summer's ‘All Souls Hill’ with an influential mix of Celtic and rootsy Americana.

title: TONY CHRISTIE
description: The 79-year-old blue eyed soul man and hit record maker whose ‘Avenues And Alleyways’ and ‘Amarillo’ have become singalong standards in more recent times.

title: CHRIS DIFFORD
description: The Squeeze lyricist and songwriting don famed for penning ‘Cool For Cats’ and ‘Up The Junction’; glorious invocations of another time and place.

title: GRAINNE DUFFY
description: Pioneering rootsy blues and edgy rock from the much-travelled and internationally-acclaimed County Monaghan performer.

title: LAURA VEIRS
description: Alternative folk songwriter with 11 albums over her 25-year career with some poignant and much-loved first-hand tales of the world and its worries.

title: KATHERINE PRIDDY
description: The folk prodigy whose nimble guitar and soaring vocal has matured into an evocative higher ground informed by Celtic roots and aching Americana.

title: HANNAH HOLLAND

The cultural melting pot of London, community, musical exploration and the transcendent potential of dancefloor have always been her biggest inspiration.

title: OVERMONO (LIVE)

title: MIDLAND
description: Through his productions, DJ sets and record labels, Midland's output comes across as unassuming and surprising in equal measure, at once subtle, refined and totally raucous.

title: SAMA' ABDULHADI

Her sets, while rooted in high-octane, punchy techno, have a distinguished and defined ark, encompassing a broad range of sounds in their beginning and end.

title: HIGHER INTELLIGENCE AGENCY
description: The Birmingham-based Higher Intelligence Agency is DJ/musician Bobby Bird. Musically, he pitches his creative tent somewhere between the ambient and experimental techno camps, with breakbeat, electro-style rhythms and a song-oriented melodic and harmonic base informing the bulk of his most recent work.

title: HOT CHIP (DJ SET)
description: There's something odd about Hot Chip. Some fracture between conception and actuality that makes them all the more intriguing. Ostensibly Hot Chip sign up to the HipHop dream as espoused by MTV Cribs and presumably as lived by, ooh, Pharrell Williams? They just seem to have some problems translating it to Wandsworth, SE London, is all. In fact they seem to have trouble squaring it with the equal, but to some extent opposite, influence of, say, Bill Callahan from Smog. Or Lambchop. Or Crystal Gayle. So, instead of doing the obvious thing and working out what sort of band they are going to be, they conclude that they will be all of them at once. And then they'll make it all in a room smaller than the box room at your Mum's house. With whatever's lying around. That is, whatever's lying around - toy trumpets, kazoos, blah. This to conform to a cherished idea of Brian Wilson's that, in the studio, anything goes.

title: DANCE SYSTEM
description: His DJ sets mix up everything from hypnotic techno to kicking house and, rather than playing all the big hits, he selects the records that make most sense at the time. He is well known for his classy and considered taste. Muallem has always focused his attentions on the communal experience of dancing. This love was incubated in Munich, a city where Muallem first found himself sneaking into clubs at the tender age of 15.

title: JAMES HILLARD (HORSE MEAT DISCO)
description: Horse Meat Disco has evolved into a powerful force in queer and club culture as a whole, while staying local to its original home, each and every Sunday. Co-founded by James Hillard and Jim Stanton, and encompassing residents Severino and Luke Howard, the crew continue to maintain not only the weekly Sunday party, but a number of residencies in cities across the world, alongside a kaleidoscope of club appearances, festival dates and specially curated mixes.

title: HONEY DIJON
description: HONEY DIJON returns to the Somerset sweatbox to bring authentic New York City realness. Honey Dijon's brazen style blends all genres without looking to the past. She captivates with her instinct, versatile sound and dazzles the club and fashion circuit in London, Paris, Berlin and New York.

title: SOUL SUMMIT
description: SOUL SUMMIT, Brooklyn’s free community House sound system, keeping New York’s original House music community alive and kicking.

title: PROSUMER
description: Vision, passion and knowledge make Prosumer a guardian of house music history and one of the formative artists, influential DJs and important producers of our days.

title: LUKE SOLOMON
description: No-one could debate Luke Solomon’s dance music credentials. From setting up the seminal label Classic Recordings with Derrick Carter to taking quirky house to the UK Top 10 and international charts, with his band Freaks, to DJing around the globe and performing live, Luke has been there for many of the more interesting 4/4 moments of the last decade.

title: PANGAEA X PARIAH
description: Pangaea, aka Kevin McAuley, makes electronic dance music that draws its energy from the bleeding edges between sounds. Steering clear of the self-perpetuating feedback loops that often exist within established scenes, his tracks instead express the elusive and innovative qualities that characterise club genres in their infancy. The result is music which ranks among both the strangest and most banging dance music to emerge from the UK in the last decade. Pariah is the pseudonym of London based producer Arthur Cayzer, whose series of releases on legendary Belgian label R&S has established him as one of the most exciting talents to emerge from the UK in recent years.

title: JOY ORBISON
description: Peter O'Grady, better known as Joy Orbison, Is an English electronic musician. His style is a coalescence of house, dubstep, UK funky, UK garage and old school jungle.

title: SHYGIRL (LIVE)
description: London-based rapper, songwriter, and DJ Shygirl makes brash, charging pop songs that draw from grime, post-industrial hip-hop, and experimental club styles.

title: FLOATING POINTS
description: Sam Shepherd aka Floating Points has applied his love for gritty funk, slick R&B, and avant-garde jazz to house, techno, and orchestral compositions that have tended to be equally stimulating through club sound systems and headphones.

title: DJRUM
description: Djrum is a perennially acclaimed underground artist, since his first release in 2010 who’s quietly built a list of fans that reads like a who’s who of contemporary dance music for his ability to deftly fuse a range of genres from jazz, hip hop and dubstep to ambient and techno.

title: TASH LC
description: In little time London based artist Tash LC has established herself as an assured DJ, host and presenter across both radio and club mediums. With the backing of some of dance music’s most influential institutions and an effortless ability to command a dance floor, Tash is quickly becoming one of the UK's most exciting new talents.

Upon his move to Berlin two years on he continued his personal journey of establishing a coherent, creative and cheerful musical language, constantly refining his skills, style and knowledge until present day.

title: BRAWTHER (LIVE)

title: CHAPTER 10

title: MICHELLE MANETTI
description: DJ, vocalist, promoter & producer Michelle Manetti blossomed from being an underage clubber in the Late 90s UK Rave scene, into a well-loved and well-respected DJ and stalwart of East London's Queer scene. With over 17years of DJ-ing under her belt, it's safe to say she's no novice to the decks, with the passion, skill, panache and record collection of a well-established and well-refined DJ.

title: JUSTIN STRAUSS
description: JUSTIN STRAUSS is one of the most sought-after producers on the planet. His work with Tina Turner, Beyonce, Luther Vandross, Depeche Mode, Jimmy Cliff, B-52s, Sergio Mendez speaks for itself.

title: GIDEON
description: Gideön is co-founder, creative director and musical curator of Block9 at Glastonbury Festival, home to underground queer nightlife institutions NYC Downlow, Genosys Sound System and IICON. As well as Gideön’s main residency at NYC Downlow, he is also resident and co-booker for the London’s hottest underground queer party Adonis.

title: TODD EDWARDS
description: Fifteen years after his music was played at the first ever NYC Downlow in 2007, TODD EDWARDS, the Godfather of UK Garage, New Jersey’s most celebrated export finally comes home to roost. The Downlow children will be waiting with open arms to welcome him into The NYC Downlow family.

title: VIRGINIA
description: Berlin’s VIRGINIA remains one of Germany’s most celebrated talents. Her knowledge of House is second to none. Be prepared for her to slay!

title: CHRIS CRUSE
description: Chris Cruse's sound is equally influenced by dark warehouses and Los Angeles sunshine. Frequently playing events in the US (Coachella, FYF Fest) and Europe (Panorama Bar, Cocktail d'Amore, NYC Downlow, Dalston Superstore), his mainstay is a party of his own creation, Spotlight, which aims to reclaim and celebrate the queer roots of house, techno, disco, and other forms of dance music.

title: FLOORPLAN
description: Floorplan is the father-daughter duo of Robert & Lyric Hood who have re-positioned the euphoric feel of gospel into their disco, funk and soul styled house across the world’s dancefloors.

title: GIANT SWAN (DJ SET)
description: Giant Swan is the brainchild of Robin Stewart & Harry Wright; an acerbic marriage of energised, aggressive dance music, quaking bass and hypnotic electronic noise.

title: JUAN RAMOS
description: Juan Ramos is a Puerto Rican-American DJ and producer currently residing in Berlin, Germany. He is the resident DJ of Discodromo's Cocktail d'Amore party and Berlin Wilde Renate. Thus, he has created a niche at the vanguard of finely curated music that explores various styles and eras. His reputation for elusive mixing and fearless selection has earned him coveted spots in premier clubs and events across Europe and the US.

title: FELIX DICKINSON
description: Felix has been part of the UK's underground dance scene for the last 3 decades, learning his trade DJing at free parties and illegal raves and co-founding his first record label Ugly Music in the 90's.

title: PLACID

In her past 8 years as a DJ, she has earned herself a place in the scene, by being the mastermind behind two of the most interesting projects in the city. She is the co-founder of MARICAS, an LGBTQ+ collective/nightclub in Barcelona, that has earned worldwide recognition in less than two years.

title: WILSON PHOENIX
description: Nyra, aka Ryan Davis has amassed a solid discography of no frills house and techno expertly designed to turbocharge dance floors. His effortlessly effective, inventively rhythmic style found favour with bosses at esteemed labels

title: DAVE HARVEY

Although much of his work goes on behind the scenes, Dave’s passion for DJing and his involvement in big events over the years has lead to playing DJ sets all over the world and gaining priceless experience in the process.
